dataSource: LOGIS ePermits (epermits.logis.org) — Building, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, and Fire permit records
notes: Deep coverage across all major permit systems — Building, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, and Fire — matched by address.
Fire records reach back the furthest of any city currently on Tarn — to 1978.

summary: Maple Grove is covered by a deep extract from the LOGIS ePermits system: nearly 134,000 permits spanning Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Building, and Fire — Fire records back to 1978, the deepest history of any city currently on Tarn — matched by address.
